name: DECA Manufacturing, Inc.
old_description: Count on us for quality stock, dependable shipping, and flexibility that meets YOUR specifications & timeline.
about:
DECA Manufacturing, Inc. operates from Lexington, Ohio, where it has been owned and operated since its founding. The company is led by President and CEO Cameron Haring, who has been recognized by Forbes for his investments in the business. While the exact founding year is not disclosed, DECA notes over 40 years in the business of making manufacturers look good.

As a contract manufacturer, DECA specializes in custom wire harnesses, cable assemblies, box builds, and thermal products acquired from Thermtrol. Its capabilities span automated wire cutting and stripping, lead making, applicator presses, modular terminal crimping, laser wire stripping, overmold plastic injection, hand soldering (IPC Class 3), potting, and design/prototype services. The company handles medium to large volume production runs while also accommodating smaller orders and prototypes. In-house testing includes Cirrus test stands, pull testing, crimp height and force monitoring, and cross-section analysis, with custom test fixtures built for complex harnesses.

DECA serves a diverse customer base across Tier I automotive, military/aerospace, commercial equipment, life sciences, food processing, IoT devices, and value-added connectivity and PCB assembly. The company also supports higher-level assemblies, box builds, and reverse engineering of specialty parts.

DECA emphasizes flexibility that meets the customer's timeline, not its own, along with quality stock and dependable shipping. The company combines integrity with an entrepreneurial spirit, maintaining a reputation for excellent customer service and quality workmanship. It also invests in the next generation through hands-on learning experiences.
